name: How do I maintain my new bathtub after replacement to ensure its longevity?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain my new bathtub after replacement to ensure its longevity?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure the longevity of your new bathtub, regular cleaning with non-abrasive cleaners is essential to prevent surface damage. Avoid using harsh chemicals, scouring pads, or steel wool, which can scratch or dull the finish. Promptly address any leaks from faucets or drains to prevent water damage to the tub's surround or subfloor. Additionally, for bathtubs with special finishes, always follow the manufacturer's specific care instructions. Hometelligent Inc. recommends checking for any hairline cracks or persistent discoloration during routine cleaning to address minor issues before they become major problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain your new bathtub by cleaning with non-abrasive cleaners, avoiding harsh chemicals, addressing leaks promptly, and following manufacturer care instructions.
